- email: TEXT

- phone: TEXT

PRIMARY KEY (member_id)
FOREIGN KEY (link_to_major) REFERENCES major (major_id)
FOREIGN KEY (zip) REFERENCES zip_code (zip_code)

arguments.sql:
SELECT a.college,
       COUNT(*) AS roster_count,
       COUNT(a.major_id) AS matched_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.major_id) AS distinct_major_count
FROM main.member AS m
LEFT JOIN main.major AS a ON a.major_id = m.link_to_major
GROUP BY a.college
ORDER BY roster_count DESC, a.college

arguments.sql:
WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT a.college, COUNT(DISTINCT a.major_id) AS major_count
    FROM main.member AS m
    JOIN main.major AS a ON a.major_id = m.link_to_major
    GROUP BY a.college
)
SELECT college, major_count
FROM college_counts
WHERE major_count = (SELECT MAX(major_count) FROM college_counts)
ORDER BY college
